notes.title: Summer Pockets Update #1
notes.content:
We updated Summer Pockets and fixed some bugs that occurred with some systems.
Your save data won't be deleted by this update.

In case you changed the text font during the first startup or inside the TEXT tab (Config), please click on "Return to Default" if the text is not displayed correctly. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36758661/8295d4b5700b64643f269044758b755872f2bf7d.jpg[/img]

You may also need to reinstall the game if it won't start up/proceed correctly. 

Additionally, here is the official Microsoft help page for adding missing fonts:
https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/deployment/windows-10-missing-fonts


Finally we are also adding Steam Badges, Trading Cards, Profile Backgrounds and Emoticons in one of the next updates.

Thank you very much for your patience.
